import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    readings = inputs["readings"].copy()

    # Row-level validation
    is_bad = (
        readings["value"].isna()
        | (readings["value"] < 0)
        | (readings["value"] > 1000)
    )
    readings["_is_bad"] = is_bad

    # Batch-level aggregation
    batch_stats = (
        readings.groupby("batch_id")["_is_bad"]
        .agg(bad_row_count="sum", total_rows="count")
        .reset_index()
    )
    batch_stats["batch_reject_pct"] = (
        batch_stats["bad_row_count"] * 100.0 / batch_stats["total_rows"]
    ).round(2)
    batch_stats["_quarantine"] = (
        batch_stats["bad_row_count"] * 100 > batch_stats["total_rows"] * 20
    )

    readings = readings.merge(
        batch_stats[["batch_id", "batch_reject_pct", "_quarantine"]],
        on="batch_id",
        how="left",
    )

    quarantine_mask = readings["_quarantine"]

    cols = ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]

    readings_quarantine = readings.loc[
        quarantine_mask, cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    readings_clean = readings.loc[
        (~quarantine_mask) & (~readings["_is_bad"]), cols
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    readings_rejects = readings.loc[
        (~quarantine_mask) & (readings["_is_bad"]), cols
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": readings_clean,
        "readings_rejects": readings_rejects,
        "readings_quarantine": readings_quarantine,
    }
